attempts.rationale: I want a simple robust baseline to gauge performance; the series has strong trend and seasonality but ranking is unstable, so a mean over all models should work reasonably.

decision.justification: Selected 'median' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.8836. Series context: trend strength 1.0 and seasonal strength 0.9999; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau 0.228); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 1.202.
